# S13 — move X --before X drops the item from the in-memory index

**Findings:** found auditing the machine interface · **Size: S** · **Tree:** slicer

## Why

`ops.move` pops the item out of the list before computing its target index. When the
target is the item itself, `index.position(X)` then raises on a list that no longer
contains it, and the function exits without reinserting and without saving.

Disk is untouched, so the damage is invisible in the CLI, where the process exits
immediately after. In the TUI, or any caller holding state across operations, the item is
simply gone from the in-memory index until the next load.
